correctness.rationale: The published density is a degree-six polynomial tilt of the logistic kernel when \(\alpha\ne0\), and a degree-four tilt when \(\alpha=0\). The logistic kernel is asymptotic to \(e^{-x}\) on the right and \(e^x\) on the left. The identical leading polynomial coefficient on both sides yields balanced survival asymptotics, MGF convergence exactly for \(-1<t<1\), and hazard limits equal to one. The packaged checker independently verifies the asymptotic ratios and quadrature.

value.rationale: Tail flexibility is an advertised motivation of the model and is repeatedly attributed to the single shape parameter. The exact result shows instead that the far-tail exponential rate, MGF boundary, tail balance, and limiting reliability rates are invariant in \(\alpha\). This materially changes interpretation for extreme-risk and reliability use, while still allowing the source's finite-range skewness and modality effects.
